name: Meridian Research
purpose: An AI research agent app where a signed-in user submits a research question, the agent runs a sequence of steps, and each step's activity and result is recorded and shown as a timeline, ending in a synthesized answer.
actors: Research Agent (runs steps via a provider adapter)

entities.name: Research
relationships: stores the research question and final synthesis

entities.name: Step
relationships: carries name, status, input, result, and position in the run

workflows.name: Sign in and start a research project
workflows.description: User submits a research question from the new-research form.

workflows.name: Run the agent
workflows.description: Agent executes steps in order; each step's status and result is persisted as it completes.

workflows.name: View the timeline
workflows.description: Research show page renders the recorded steps as a timeline plus the final synthesis.

workflows.name: Review past runs
workflows.description: User's research index lists previous questions, dates, and statuses.

seed_demo: A demo user with one completed research run ("The history of espresso") showing a full timeline of completed steps and a final synthesis, so the timeline UI is visible immediately.
